title: 10 Beginner CNC Bas-Relief Projects to Carve This Weekend, in the Right Order
excerpt: Ten relief carvings sized for a Saturday and one piece of stock, sorted from easiest to hardest, each with the file, the wood, the bits, the time, and the one thing it teaches. Plus the four-bit kit that covers all of them.
seo_title: 10 Beginner CNC Relief Carving Projects (With Files, Bits and Times)
seo_description: Ten beginner CNC bas-relief projects in order of difficulty, each with a real STL file, stock size, bits, carve time and what it teaches: a magnolia, a heart, a wolf, a wreath, a lighthouse, a name sign, a pet, a raven, a face and a landscape.

email.subject: Your first ten relief carvings, in the order that makes the tenth one easy
email.intro:
The first ten bas-relief carvings you make decide whether you fall in love with the craft or quietly list your router for sale. Most people start with the wrong one: a face, or a landscape, or a portrait of the dog. It comes out soft, and they blame the machine.

We rewrote our beginner guide so the order does the teaching. Ten projects, each one a real file, sized for a Saturday and one board, each teaching exactly one thing the next one needs. Start at the magnolia and by the tenth you will be carving overnight landscapes without a second thought.
